<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD's source array pulls a prebuilt binary tarball over HTTPS from the project's own GitHub releases. The sha256sums array supplies a specific checksum (not SKIP), which is ordinary practice for verifying the downloaded artifact. There are no top‑level commands, eval, base64 decoding, curl|bash pipelines, or other dangerous constructs executed while the PKGBUILD is sourced. The pkgver is hard‑coded (0.11.1) and no pkgver() function is defined. The package() function only runs later (outside the --nobuild --noprepare scope). Consequently, running `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare` merely downloads and extracts the source archive; it does not execute any malicious code.
</details>
